item.description:
0.13.0

  • Agents can read your sessions — only the ones you mark with File ▸ Visible to Agents. They can read, not type, and passwords, keys and tokens are redacted first. Settings ▸ Agents has the setup command.
  • One look across the app: every form uses the same card layout, with one highlighted button that Return presses.
  • Fixed: Return in the credentials window now adds instead of closing.
